svg.text: $ npm run demo — real devnet run (excerpt of demo-output.txt, ⋮ = lines omitted, … = truncated)
solana-agent-pay — an AI agent that pays for API calls by itself (official x402 on Solana devnet)
/supported → x402 v2 · exact · solana:EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1 · feePayer CKPKJWNdJEqa81x7CkZ14BVPiY6y16Sxs7owznqtWYp5
━━━ 3. Scenario A — a task that needs paid data ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
👤 Task: 東京と大阪の今日の天気と空気の質を比べて、夕方に散歩するならどちらが向いているか教えてください。
🔧 request_api({"path":"/api/weather","query":{"city":"Tokyo"}})
[server] 402 /api/weather?city=Tokyo (no payment)
💳 402 Payment Required: /api/weather?city=Tokyo → 0.02 dUSDC (feePayer CKPKJWNd…)
🔧 pay_and_retry({"quote_id":"q1","justification":"Tokyo weather needed for the walk comparison."})
✍️ official @x402/svm client built + partially signed the transfer → retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
[server] facilitator verify: ok (payer 3FEmjYNBFa5ncR8nUE7UUwx4G6x98MWS3TYAzNxT7w5U)
[server] facilitator settle: ok tx=2mjECGC2GBpJkN4RQ8L1qDySs9xYxF8SgXeyoHQecggM812qd17LEmMk1fwVH37gFeNfNyDRufFnsBZ9ddYto2vh
[server] 200 /api/weather?city=Tokyo (with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE)
💸 PAID 0.02 dUSDC for /api/weather?city=Tokyo (settled by facilitator)
tx: https://explorer.solana.com/tx/2mjECGC2GBpJkN4RQ8L1qDySs9xYxF8SgXeyoHQecggM812qd17LEmMk1fwVH37gFeNfNyDRufFnsBZ9ddYto2vh?cluster=devnet
[server] settlement pending (tx n9VEzFPgJnfq…) — reconciling
[server] facilitator settle: recovered after pending, tx=n9VEzFPgJnfqutDE1tkXq4iE1wWUgcZQexbp88EiZ5QhkF6knqyujV46PZBRiTBBkoUpGrruMBpoSBCtqvy1e…
🤖 Final answer:
**結論:夕方の散歩は大阪のほうが向いています。**
━━━ 4. Scenario B — a purchase above the per-call cap ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔧 request_api({"path":"/api/premium/forecast-report","query":{"city":"Tokyo"}})
💳 402 Payment Required: /api/premium/forecast-report?city=Tokyo → 0.5 dUSDC (feePayer CKPKJWNd…)
東京のプレミアム48時間予報レポートは購入しませんでした。価格が0.50 dUSDCで、1回あたりの上限0.1 dUSDCと残り予算0.24 dUSDCの両方を超えているため…
━━━ 5. Interop — an off-the-shelf @x402/fetch client pays the server ━━━━━━
✔ wrapFetchWithPayment(fetch, x402Client) → HTTP 200, PAYMENT-RESPONSE success=true
tx: https://explorer.solana.com/tx/4XXXk2S9KS26ufMWafwZWxTsGGvtvezMqf1iezu85tVnFdyP6uR3QWonEEeDZZ8fSNVEqjgDnZSYpfrcAm8DNDeM?cluster=devnet
✔ over-cap payment refused by the agent's wallet guard before signing: per_call_cap_exceeded
✔ tampered 402 (payTo changed) refused: SpendGuard recipient_not_allowlisted; official client policy → "All payment requirements were filtered…
✔ replayed PAYMENT-SIGNATURE rejected by server: HTTP 402 (replayed_payment)
✔ same payload sent straight to the facilitator: verify rejected (invalid_exact_svm_transaction_simulation_failed) — no double charge
✔ tx pays 0.019999 but claims 0.02 → rejected by facilitator verify: HTTP 402 (invalid_exact_svm_payload_amount_mismatch)
✔ tx pays another wallet but claims the server's payTo → rejected by facilitator verify: HTTP 402 (invalid_exact_svm_payload_recipient_mismatc…
✔ demo completed: on-chain amounts match the agent's ledger + the interop payment
